defaultCta: Enter Hakusyaku MUSIAM and ask the Count which work belongs in your space. No purchase decision is required.

assets.hook: Build a wall that remembers the day you began.
assets.caption: Office art should do more than fill a surface. 33 IGNITION is a Collector Preview for founders who want one room to hold the instant a venture or body of work caught fire.

assets.hook: A meeting room does not need another explanation.
assets.caption: Some decisions should be felt before they are presented. 33 IGNITION turns a music-world emblem into a 60cm-square focal point for a founder office or design studio.

assets.hook: A new chapter deserves a mark stronger than a date.
assets.caption: For a company, studio or private room entering its next phase. A formal Offer opens only after the specification, destination and made-to-order terms are confirmed.

assets.hook: A room where guests somehow feel they have returned.
assets.caption: A Town Called Almost Home is conceived for boutique hotels and second homes that want belonging rather than generic decoration—a landscape for the feeling of almost returning.

assets.hook: Not your birthplace. Still, your breathing changes here.
assets.caption: The work begins as a folk record and becomes a quiet visual anchor for a guest suite, residence or lounge. Collector Preview, Edition of three, made to order after payment.

assets.hook: A long-stay room needs a story before it needs an address.
assets.caption: Hospitality can create recognition before explanation. See whether this imagined town belongs in the room you are shaping; no purchase decision is required.

assets.hook: A quiet room and a powerless room are not the same.
assets.caption: BALIAN brings ritual, purification and equilibrium into a visual center for retreats and spa interiors that need force as well as stillness.

assets.hook: Give the eye one place to return, and space becomes ritual.
assets.caption: A dense square image drawn from a musical journey through sacred places in Bali. Explore its fit for a contemplative hospitality space before any formal Offer.

assets.hook: A hotel's memory is made after the guest looks away.
assets.caption: For a retreat, spa or intimate hotel seeking a world of its own rather than borrowed calm. Edition of three; production begins after confirmed payment.

assets.hook: Place a question larger than the answer in your study.
assets.caption: Deus sive Natura—God, or Nature—translates a Spinozan music world into a focal point for rooms made for deeper thought.

assets.hook: A beautiful room does not need another expensive object.
assets.caption: It may need a symbol. This limited Collector Preview is conceived for a private study, wellness room or residence where nature and cosmos remain inseparable.

assets.hook: A room that remembers you are part of nature.
assets.caption: Darkness, light and immanent nature meet in a 60cm-square metal print candidate. Ask the Count whether the work belongs in your space before deciding anything.
